title: සිංහල භාෂාව හා සාහිත්‍යය - 6 ශ්‍රේණිය (Sinhala Language and Literature, Grade 6), single volume
edition: Educational Publications Department; 1st print 2014, reprinted 2015-2019 (6th print 2019); ISBN 978-955-25-0254-5; server file Last-Modified 2019-09-20
notes: edupub lists it as 'සිංහල භාෂාව හා සාහිත්‍යය - නව විෂය නිර්දේශය' (bookId 1260). The book has one part only: 21 units, 143 printed pages (PDF page = book page + 10). The text uses a legacy FM-Abhaya-style font, so PDF text extraction gives ASCII-mapped glyphs. For this analysis it was converted to Unicode with an approximate converter; a few rare glyphs may be wrong.

title: සිංහල භාෂාව හා සාහිත්‍යය - 6 ශ්‍රේණිය - ගුරු මාර්ගෝපදේශය (Teacher's Guide, Grade 6), includes the Grade 6 syllabus
edition: National Institute of Education, Department of Sinhala; 1st edition 2015 (syllabus implemented from 2015)
notes: Linked from nie.lk/seletguide2 (Sinhala medium) > Grade 6 > 'සිංහල භාෂාව (2015)'. 60 PDF pages. The syllabus grid (competencies, competency levels, content, learning outcomes, periods) is on PDF pp. 16-27. Lesson guidance for each competency level is on PDF pp. 29-60, one page per level. Legacy font, as with the textbook.

title: Grade 6 Sinhala Language and Literature syllabus (2015)
notes: No separate syllabus PDF was found or needed: the full syllabus is printed inside the teacher's guide (same file as above).

title: දෙවන බස සිංහල - 6 ශ්‍රේණිය (Second Language Sinhala, Grade 6) textbook for Tamil-medium students
edition: EPD, listed as '2016 නව විෂය නිර්දේශය' (bookId 1649)
notes: Recorded as a link only. This is a different subject (Sinhala as a second language), not a translation of the mother-tongue Sinhala course. Sinhala as a first language has no English-medium version.

title: දෙවන බස සිංහල - 6 ශ්‍රේණිය ගුරු මාර්ගෝපදේශය (Second Language Sinhala, Grade 6, Teacher's Guide)
Grade 6 reform modules (2026), status note
notes: In January 2026 Cabinet postponed the Grade 6 reform to 2027, and in 2026 Grade 6 is taught with the previous syllabus and textbooks (news link, not a .gov.lk source). As of Nov 2026, edupub.gov.lk and nie.lk list no reformed Grade 6 Sinhala module. Only first-term Grade 6 modules were printed, and those are not published on official sites for Sinhala. If the reform starts in 2027, this path must be rebuilt from the new module.
